_source: L13 (work plan 2). Accessories carry small 5e bonuses (ac, saves, hp, speed, hit, dmg); cosmetics change only the look. Bought with gold (!wear <item>, !dye <colour>); later with channel points (T1). Names in Bellmire's plain voice.

nightwatch_ring.name: Ring of the Night Watch
nightwatch_ring.flavour: Iron, worn thin by the watch that wore it before you.

hearth_amulet.name: Hearthstone Amulet
hearth_amulet.flavour: Warm to the touch on the coldest floor.

lamplight_amulet.name: Lamplighter's Amulet
lamplight_amulet.flavour: The guild gives these to the ones who keep the lamps.

guild_cloak.name: Guild Cloak
guild_cloak.flavour: Grey wool, the guild's stitch at the collar.

road_boots.name: Boots of the West Road
road_boots.flavour: They have walked further than you have.

quiet_boots.name: Soft Boots
quiet_boots.flavour: Felt soles. The dark does not hear you coming.

scar_ring.name: Scarglass Ring
scar_ring.flavour: A sliver of the scar, set in iron. Cold, and a little wrong.

mason_ring.name: Mason's Band
mason_ring.flavour: Guild iron, squared at the shoulders like everything the masons make.

oath_ring.name: Oathkeeper's Ring
oath_ring.flavour: Sworn on the door, and kept on the hand.

grain_amulet.name: Grainward Charm
grain_amulet.flavour: A seed from the first harvest, sealed in wax.

ward_pendant.name: Wardstone Pendant
ward_pendant.flavour: It hums when a spell goes wrong nearby.

ferry_locket.name: Ferrywife's Locket
ferry_locket.flavour: A keepsake from the Ford. She is still waiting for the boat.

watch_mantle.name: Watchman's Mantle
watch_mantle.flavour: Heavy at the shoulders, cut for the long walls.

lamp_cloak.name: Lamplighter's Cloak
lamp_cloak.flavour: Smells of lamp-oil and late nights.

scarweave_cloak.name: Scarweave Cloak
scarweave_cloak.flavour: Woven from thread the scar touched. It never sits quite still.

scout_boots.name: Scout's Boots
scout_boots.flavour: Quiet on gravel, quieter on stone.

mason_mitts.name: Mason's Mitts
mason_mitts.flavour: Stone-callused, and two sizes too big.

pick_gloves.name: Pickman's Gloves
pick_gloves.flavour: They know the weight of a swing better than you do.

hollow_ring.name: Hollowbone Ring
hollow_ring.flavour: Carved from a lord's knuckle. It was not asked.

market_ring.name: Market Seal
market_ring.flavour: The trade-master's ring - it opens purses, not doors.

bell_amulet.name: Clapperless Charm
bell_amulet.flavour: Shaped like the bell that never rings. It keeps you quiet too.

scribe_amulet.name: Guild Scribe's Seal
scribe_amulet.flavour: The roll is written in this hand.

raid_cloak.name: Raider's Trophy Cloak
raid_cloak.flavour: Taken off a raider who will not miss it.

deep_cloak.name: Deepwarden's Cloak
deep_cloak.flavour: The deeper you go, the colder it keeps you honest.

gate_boots.name: Gatewarden's Boots
gate_boots.flavour: They have stood a long watch at the Keep door.

fen_boots.name: Fen-strider's Boots
fen_boots.flavour: Mud slides off them like it was never there.

forge_grips.name: Forgemaster's Grips
forge_grips.flavour: The last pair the old smith wore.

tanner_gloves.name: Tanner's Gloves
tanner_gloves.flavour: Supple, and they never let go.

e3po_signet.name: E3PO's Signet
e3po_signet.flavour: The Commander's own seal. He always comes back for it - he comes back for everything.

barracks_key.name: Barracks Key
barracks_key.flavour: The guard's own door. Hurt enough and E3PO walks through it, then walks back out whole.

bellrope_wraps.name: Bellringer's Wraps
bellrope_wraps.flavour: Rope-burn calluses, lent to you with the rope.

drover_boots.name: Drover's Boots
drover_boots.flavour: Twenty miles a day behind cattle. They remember the pace.

chapel_amulet.name: Chapel Candle Amulet
chapel_amulet.flavour: A stub of chapel wax in a tin cage. Lit once, for you.

sedge_ring.name: Sedge's Toll-Ring
sedge_ring.flavour: Taken off the hand that took the toll.

harl_cloak.name: Red Harl's Cloak
harl_cloak.flavour: Red where it was always red. Harl has no further use for it.

ashfoot_boots.name: Ashfoot's Boots
ashfoot_boots.flavour: Cob walked quiet. You will walk quieter.

weasel_gloves.name: The Weasel's Gloves
weasel_gloves.flavour: Thin fingers, quick work. The guild asked no questions.

carp_charm.name: Grinning Carp Charm
carp_charm.flavour: River-bone, grinning. The Carp itself is still down there.

scarward_ring.name: Scarward Ring
scarward_ring.flavour: Turned against the scar. The scar notices being refused.

mourner_cloak.name: Mourner's Grey
mourner_cloak.flavour: Worn once for every name the Chronicle keeps.

mill_mitts.name: Millhand's Mitts
mill_mitts.flavour: Hands that shift full sacks all day hit like full sacks.

gate_whistle.name: Gatehouse Whistle
gate_whistle.flavour: One blast for bandits. Two for the scar. Nobody blows it twice.

commander_mantle.name: Commander's Field Mantle
commander_mantle.flavour: E3PO wore one to the wall and walked back. He always walks back.

tally_ring.name: Tallykeeper's Ring
tally_ring.flavour: Notched once a season. The notches go a long way round.

thaw_ring.name: Ring of the Thaw
thaw_ring.flavour: Cut from the Ford's ice the morning it broke. Cold, and glad to be.

blight_charm.name: Blightward Charm
blight_charm.flavour: A rot-black ear of grain set in glass. Worn as a warning, not a trophy.

bucketline_gloves.name: Bucket-line Gloves
bucketline_gloves.flavour: Scorched to the palm. In Bellmire that counts as a qualification.

barracks_cloak.name: Barracks Watch-cloak
barracks_cloak.flavour: Issued by the Commander himself, which means it was counted first.

crater_ring.name: Crater-glass Ring
crater_ring.flavour: Glass from the night the sky fell. It hums when the scar does.

drover_spurs.name: Drover's Spurs
drover_spurs.flavour: Walked cattle through a hurricane and did not lose one. Ask him about it. He will tell you.

clapper_ring.name: Clapperless Ring
clapper_ring.flavour: Cast from the bell's missing tongue. It keeps whatever it takes.

architect_ring.name: Architect's Ring
architect_ring.flavour: One of his toys, sized for a finger. It fits nobody properly and everybody anyway.

toll_ring.name: Toll Ring
toll_ring.flavour: Two coins hammered flat. Paid going down, paid coming up.

chitin_ring.name: Brood-iron Ring
chitin_ring.flavour: Chitin set in iron. The walls down there wear rings too.

flaskcount_amulet.name: Flask-counter's Amulet
flaskcount_amulet.flavour: COUNT THE FLASKS, engraved small, so he would have to lean in.

doorkeep_amulet.name: Doorkeeper's Amulet
doorkeep_amulet.flavour: KEEP THE DOOR, in letters worn smooth by one thumb.

thawbell_amulet.name: Thaw-bell Amulet
thawbell_amulet.flavour: Rung the morning the ice let go. Warm ever since, or near enough.

mourncoil_amulet.name: Mourncoil Scale
mourncoil_amulet.flavour: A single scale, still turning when nothing turns it.

chronicle_cloak.name: Chronicler's Cloak
chronicle_cloak.flavour: Ink to the cuffs. Everything that happens to you gets written down.

gravewyrm_cloak.name: Gravewyrm Hide Cloak
gravewyrm_cloak.flavour: Heavy as a kept promise and about as comfortable.

ossuary_cloak.name: Ossuary Mantle
ossuary_cloak.flavour: Bone buttons. They were going spare.

bucketline_cloak.name: Bucket-line Cloak
bucketline_cloak.flavour: Soaked a hundred times and never once burned.

tollgate_boots.name: Toll-gate Boots
tollgate_boots.flavour: They know the short way round the gate. Soon you will too.

nightwing_boots.name: Nightwing Boots
nightwing_boots.flavour: Light enough to be mistaken for the thing overhead.

chapel_clogs.name: Chapel Clogs
chapel_clogs.flavour: Blessed once, cheaply, and it appears to have taken.

craterglass_boots.name: Craterglass Boots
craterglass_boots.flavour: Soles glassed by whatever landed. Nothing cuts up through them now.

bellringer_gloves.name: Bell-ringer's Gloves
bellringer_gloves.flavour: No clapper left to pull, so the hands found other work.

duchess_gloves.name: Pale Duchess's Gloves
duchess_gloves.flavour: Far too fine for you. They do not appear to mind.

physic_gloves.name: Apothecary's Gloves
physic_gloves.flavour: Stained to the wrist in colours the guild will not write down.

rattling_gauntlets.name: Rattling Gauntlets
rattling_gauntlets.flavour: They clatter. So does the Host, and it never slowed them.

mortar_gloves.name: Mortarman's Gloves
mortar_gloves.flavour: The new wall went up in these. Something hit the old one first.

lampwright_ring.name: Lampwright's Ring
lampwright_ring.flavour: Turned on a wick-trimmer's bench. It keeps a flame honest.

measure_amulet.name: Amulet of the Measure
measure_amulet.flavour: Grain-weight in silver. It settles whoever wears it.

scarglass_ring.name: Scarglass Ring
scarglass_ring.flavour: Only slightly cursed, the market swears. The market swears a great deal.

crier_cloak.name: Crier's Cloak
crier_cloak.flavour: Loud cloth. Nobody shoves a man who has been shouting all morning.

fordwarden_boots.name: Fordwarden Boots
fordwarden_boots.flavour: Wet to the knee for thirty years and never once lost.

quarry_gloves.name: Quarryman's Gloves
quarry_gloves.flavour: Stone taught these hands, and stone does not teach gently.

host_amulet.name: Rattling Host Amulet
host_amulet.flavour: Strung with teeth that stopped chattering when the Host did.

tollkeep_ring.name: Tollkeep's Ring
tollkeep_ring.flavour: Sedge took a toll on that road. Somebody took the ring.

lampfast_ring.name: Lampfast Ring
lampfast_ring.flavour: Lamplighters learned early that steady hands outlive quick ones.

chalkline_gloves.name: Chalkline Gloves
chalkline_gloves.flavour: Chalk in every seam. The marks they left are still saving strangers.

stairhold_boots.name: Stairhold Boots
stairhold_boots.flavour: They held a stair long enough for four people to use it.

secondflask_amulet.name: Second Flask Amulet
secondflask_amulet.flavour: For the flask you keep back. There is always a second flask.

rollkeeper_ring.name: Roll-keeper's Ring
rollkeeper_ring.flavour: The guild wears one to write the names. It is heavier than it looks.

backstair_cloak.name: Backstair Cloak
backstair_cloak.flavour: Grey as a wall and twice as uninteresting. That is the whole trick.

pitwalk_boots.name: Pitwalker's Boots
pitwalk_boots.flavour: Thin soles on purpose - you want to feel the floor lie to you.

mender_wraps.name: Mender's Wraps
mender_wraps.flavour: Stained past washing, and every stain walked back out of the scar.

deeplamp_amulet.name: Deep-lamp Amulet
deeplamp_amulet.flavour: A thumb of lamp-glass that has been down further than most men.

warhorn_mantle.name: Warhorn Mantle
warhorn_mantle.flavour: Cut from a gate banner the raiders never got to take down.

tithe_ring.name: Tithe Ring
tithe_ring.flavour: The chapel takes a tenth of everything. This is the tenth it gave back.

cartwright_ring.name: Cartwright's Ring
cartwright_ring.flavour: A wheelwright's hands are steady or a wheelwright's hands are short.

lastcoin_ring.name: Last Coin Ring
lastcoin_ring.flavour: Hammered flat from the coin he would not spend to leave.

watchfire_ring.name: Watchfire Ring
watchfire_ring.flavour: Turned on the finger when the fire on the wall goes out.

oathwrong_ring.name: Wrong-hand Ring
oathwrong_ring.flavour: Worn on the wrong hand on purpose, so the oath knows you meant it.

ninthbell_amulet.name: Ninth Bell Amulet
ninthbell_amulet.flavour: The ninth bell means come home. Nobody has ever needed telling twice.

saltline_amulet.name: Saltline Amulet
saltline_amulet.flavour: Mire salt in a glass thumb. The rot does not like the taste of you.

kindling_amulet.name: Kindling Amulet
kindling_amulet.flavour: A splinter of the first beam of the first hall, still warm. That is not a story.

grainward_amulet.name: Grainward Amulet
grainward_amulet.flavour: Barley set in wax. Starve the town and the town stops holding the wall.

fogrun_cloak.name: Fog-run Cloak
fogrun_cloak.flavour: Cut short at the knee, because the fen does not forgive a long hem.

sparewall_cloak.name: Spare Wall Cloak
sparewall_cloak.flavour: Oiled canvas, three thicknesses. Men have called it a wall and not been joking.

wakeward_cloak.name: Wake-ward Cloak
wakeward_cloak.flavour: Worn by whoever sits up with the body. Nothing gets past the one who sits up.

mudplank_boots.name: Mudplank Boots
mudplank_boots.flavour: Flat as a plank, and the fen holds a plank far worse than a heel.

firstlight_boots.name: First Light Boots
firstlight_boots.flavour: On the feet of whoever walks the wall before the sun gets to it.

longcount_boots.name: Long Count Boots
longcount_boots.flavour: Resoled four times. Four is a number that means something down there.

ropeburn_gloves.name: Rope-burn Gloves
ropeburn_gloves.flavour: Leather over the palm, where the rope already took the skin once.

coldforge_mitts.name: Cold-forge Mitts
coldforge_mitts.flavour: For the work the smith does with the fire out. You do not ask what work.

splintwrap_gloves.name: Splint-wrap Gloves
splintwrap_gloves.flavour: Two fingers of hard cane sewn in. Hands break first and heal slowest.

bellfounder_ring.name: Bellfounder's Ring
bellfounder_ring.flavour: Cast from the spill of a bell that came out true. He kept the spill.

quarryman_ring.name: Quarryman's Ring
quarryman_ring.flavour: Stone splits where you tell it to or it splits where it likes. Learn which.

pilgrim_ring.name: Pilgrim's Ring
pilgrim_ring.flavour: Worn down to a thread of iron by a road walked twice in one life.

ferrybell_amulet.name: Ferrybell Amulet
ferrybell_amulet.flavour: A thumbnail of the ferry bell. Ring it and someone comes. Someone always has.

votive_amulet.name: Votive Amulet
votive_amulet.flavour: A candle stub in wax glass, lit once for somebody who came back up.

weighstone_amulet.name: Weighstone Amulet
weighstone_amulet.flavour: A market weight, true to the grain. The market hangs men for a false one.

thatcher_cloak.name: Thatcher's Cloak
thatcher_cloak.flavour: Reed-oiled and stiff as a roof. Rain gives up on it.

crane_cloak.name: Cranesman's Cloak
crane_cloak.flavour: Doubled at the shoulder, where the rope goes when the rope goes wrong.

pilgrim_cloak.name: Pilgrim's Cloak
pilgrim_cloak.flavour: Light, patched, and it has out-walked three better cloaks.

towpath_boots.name: Towpath Boots
towpath_boots.flavour: Cut for the bank, not the road. The bank is where the work is.

pavers_boots.name: Paver's Boots
pavers_boots.flavour: Iron under the toe, because the stone always lands the same way.

ferrystep_boots.name: Ferrystep Boots
ferrystep_boots.flavour: For standing on a deck that will not stand still. You learn or you swim.

glazier_gloves.name: Glazier's Gloves
glazier_gloves.flavour: Three thicknesses at the fingertip. Glass takes the careless hand first.

ropewalk_gloves.name: Ropewalk Gloves
ropewalk_gloves.flavour: Palms slick with tallow so the rope runs instead of taking you with it.

rivet_mitts.name: Rivet Mitts
rivet_mitts.flavour: Scorched through in four places. The fifth is the one that counts.

beeswax_gloves.name: Beeswax Gloves
beeswax_gloves.flavour: Rubbed down with the chapel's own wax. The rot slides off them.

cooper_ring.name: Cooper's Ring
cooper_ring.flavour: Banded like the barrels he hoops. Nothing he closes leaks.

orchard_ring.name: Orchard Ring
orchard_ring.flavour: Applewood set in tin. It smells of a better autumn.

reeve_ring.name: Reeve's Signet
reeve_ring.flavour: He counts the town twice a year and is wrong once.

collier_ring.name: Collier's Band
collier_ring.flavour: Charcoal under the stone, and it will not come out.

netmender_ring.name: Netmender's Ring
netmender_ring.flavour: Worn smooth by forty winters of knots.

wellhead_ring.name: Wellhead Ring
wellhead_ring.flavour: Dropped in once. The well gave it back, which it rarely does.

sawyer_amulet.name: Sawyer's Token
sawyer_amulet.flavour: A tooth off the pit saw, filed blunt so it only bites wood now.

shepherd_charm.name: Shepherd's Charm
shepherd_charm.flavour: Horn and hair. It keeps the flock calm and does the same for you.

ostler_amulet.name: Ostler's Amulet
ostler_amulet.flavour: A bit-ring from a horse that outran a raid.

chandler_amulet.name: Chandler's Amulet
chandler_amulet.flavour: Wax-dipped nine times. It burns last and longest.

threshing_amulet.name: Threshing Charm
threshing_amulet.flavour: Straw bound in a figure eight. Harvest luck, and nothing more.

hedgeward_cloak.name: Hedgeward's Cloak
hedgeward_cloak.flavour: Thorn-torn at the hem and proud of every hole.

shingler_cloak.name: Shingler's Cloak
shingler_cloak.flavour: Oiled against the rain the roof has not stopped yet.

winterwatch_cloak.name: Winterwatch Cloak
winterwatch_cloak.flavour: Two fleeces thick. The wall is colder than the dungeon.

orchard_cloak.name: Orchardman's Cloak
orchard_cloak.flavour: Deep pockets, still sticky from the pressing.

saltboiler_cloak.name: Saltboiler's Cloak
saltboiler_cloak.flavour: Stiff with brine. It has stopped worse than weather.

carter_boots.name: Carter's Boots
carter_boots.flavour: They know the road's ruts better than the carter does.

millrace_boots.name: Millrace Boots
millrace_boots.flavour: Wet to the ankle for twenty years and never rotted.

hayward_boots.name: Hayward's Boots
hayward_boots.flavour: He walks the fences at night so the fields keep their edges.

tinker_boots.name: Tinker's Boots
tinker_boots.flavour: Resoled in three towns. None of them his.

kennel_boots.name: Kennelman's Boots
kennel_boots.flavour: The hounds follow these, whoever is in them.

plaster_gloves.name: Plasterer's Gloves
plaster_gloves.flavour: Set hard at the knuckles. He stopped noticing years ago.

wheelwright_gloves.name: Wheelwright's Gloves
wheelwright_gloves.flavour: Shaped to a spoke. Your grip is a wheel's grip now.

miner_grips.name: Miner's Grips
miner_grips.flavour: Leather over knuckle-iron, for rock that argues.

baker_mitts.name: Baker's Mitts
baker_mitts.flavour: They have been in a hotter mouth than anything down there.

thresher_gloves.name: Thresher's Gloves
thresher_gloves.flavour: Flail-worn at the heel of the hand. The swing is already in them.

tanner_ring.name: Tanner's Ring
tanner_ring.flavour: Horn, cut from a beast that argued. It argues still.

fletcher_ring.name: Fletcher's Thumb-ring
fletcher_ring.flavour: Bone, for the string. Your aim is older than you are.

lockkeep_ring.name: Lockkeeper's Ring
lockkeep_ring.flavour: Brass, green at the seam. It has held a gate shut all night.

sexton_ring.name: Sexton's Ring
sexton_ring.flavour: He wore it to every burial in Bellmire and walked home from each one.

fuller_amulet.name: Fuller's Token
fuller_amulet.flavour: Lead, stamped at the cloth hall. Proof the work was done right.

skep_amulet.name: Skepward's Charm
skep_amulet.flavour: Wax, with one dead bee in it. The hive forgave him.

farrier_amulet.name: Farrier's Nail
farrier_amulet.flavour: Hung on a thong. Driven once, into something that kicked.

potter_amulet.name: Potter's Thumbmark
potter_amulet.flavour: Fired clay with his print still in it. Someone made this on purpose.

tanner_cloak.name: Tanner's Apron-cloak
tanner_cloak.flavour: Hide cured hard. It smells of the yard and it stops a knife.

weaver_cloak.name: Weaver's Long Cloak
weaver_cloak.flavour: Cloth woven so tight the rain gives up on it.

sexton_cloak.name: Sexton's Black
sexton_cloak.flavour: Worn at every grave on the hill. It knows the way back down.

lockkeep_cloak.name: Lockkeeper's Oilcloth
lockkeep_cloak.flavour: Oiled against the Ford. Water runs off it like it was told to.

bowyer_cloak.name: Bowyer's Shoulder-cloak
bowyer_cloak.flavour: Cut away at the right shoulder so the string never catches.

tanyard_boots.name: Tanyard Boots
tanyard_boots.flavour: They have stood in worse than blood, and for longer.

lockkeep_waders.name: Lockkeeper's Waders
lockkeep_waders.flavour: Stiff at the knee, dry at the toe, quick on wet stone.

kiln_boots.name: Potter's Kiln Boots
kiln_boots.flavour: Soles baked hard. A hot floor is just a floor.

hive_boots.name: Skepward's Soft Boots
hive_boots.flavour: He learned to walk so nothing woke. So did these.

gravepath_boots.name: Sexton's Hobnails
gravepath_boots.flavour: Shod for the hill path in the rain. Nothing slips them.

currier_gloves.name: Currier's Gloves
currier_gloves.flavour: Thick at the palm, for a blade you draw toward yourself.

fletcher_tabs.name: Fletcher's Tabs
fletcher_tabs.flavour: Two fingers of hard leather. The string takes them instead of you.

farrier_mitts.name: Farrier's Mitts
farrier_mitts.flavour: Hoof-scorched. The hand inside has been stepped on and kept working.

fuller_grips.name: Fuller's Grips
fuller_grips.flavour: Lime-burnt and lime-proof. They have handled worse cloth than yours.

lockkeep_gloves.name: Lockkeeper's Gloves
lockkeep_gloves.flavour: Hemp at the palm. The rope goes nowhere you did not send it.

hive_gloves.name: Skepward's Gloves
hive_gloves.flavour: Smoke-cured and gentle. Quick hands that wake nothing.

wide_hat.name: Wide-brimmed Hat
wide_hat.flavour: Rain runs off the brim instead of your collar. That is the whole of it.

feather_cap.name: Feathered Cap
feather_cap.flavour: One feather. The man who wore two was laughed out of the Ford.

straw_hat.name: Straw Hat
straw_hat.flavour: Field straw at a field price. Smells of August.

crown_of_ash.name: Ash-wood Circlet
crown_of_ash.flavour: Ash-wood bent in a circle. The old way of saying this one leads.

banner_blue.name: Keep Banner (blue)
banner_blue.flavour: Keep blue. Flown where the orders come from.

banner_red.name: Market Banner (red)
banner_red.flavour: Market red. Up on stall days, down when the stalls are.

banner_yellow.name: Craft Banner (yellow)
banner_yellow.flavour: Craft yellow. Every trade on the row claims it invented the colour.

banner_green.name: Homes Banner (green)
banner_green.flavour: Homes green. Nobody important, everybody necessary.

pet_corgi.name: a corgi
pet_corgi.flavour: Short, loud, and convinced it is a guard dog. Nobody corrects it.

pet_pug.name: a pug
pet_pug.flavour: Breathes like a bellows with a hole in it. Devoted anyway.

pet_duck.name: a duck
pet_duck.flavour: Follows you at a run. Costs almost nothing. Worth more than that.

pet_fox.name: a fox
pet_fox.flavour: Tame enough. Trust it with your boots and nothing else.

title_lamplighter.name: the Lamplighter
title_lamplighter.flavour: You kept the lamps lit. Small work, missed at once when it stops.

title_door.name: Keeper of the Door
title_door.flavour: The door held. You were at it.

title_ford.name: Friend of the Ford
title_ford.flavour: The crossing knows you. That is worth a round at the Ford.

title_scarwalker.name: Scarwalker
title_scarwalker.flavour: You went down and came back up. Once is enough to say it.

title_grain.name: Counter of Grain
title_grain.flavour: You counted the sacks. Somebody has to, and it was you.

title_bell.name: Bell without a Clapper
title_bell.flavour: Rung in silence. Only a handful will know why.

guild_hood.name: Guild Hood
guild_hood.flavour: Grey wool, guild stitch. Gets you a nod at the post.

mire_hood.name: Mire Hood
mire_hood.flavour: Cut long at the back so the fen runs off you, not into you.

watch_helm.name: Watchman's Kettle-Helm
watch_helm.flavour: Kettle-brim steel. Turns rain, turns a thrown cup, turns most of a club.

miller_cap.name: Miller's Cap
miller_cap.flavour: Flour in the seams that will never wash out. Nobody minds.

bell_coif.name: Bellringer's Coif
bell_coif.flavour: Padded at the ears. You learn to want that after one full peal.

ford_circlet.name: Ford Circlet
ford_circlet.flavour: River-silver band. Worn by whoever last kept the crossing open.

banner_temple.name: Temple Banner (white)
banner_temple.flavour: Temple white, kept white, at some cost in soap.

banner_garrison.name: Garrison Banner (steel)
banner_garrison.flavour: Steel grey. Hung without ceremony and never crooked.

banner_mill.name: Mill Banner (wheat)
banner_mill.flavour: Wheat gold. Flies when the measure is honest.

banner_ford.name: Ford Banner (river)
banner_ford.flavour: River blue. The crossing is the reason there is a town.

banner_scar.name: Scar Banner (violet)
banner_scar.flavour: Violet, the colour nothing natural is. Flown anyway.

pet_piglet.name: a piglet
pet_piglet.flavour: Clean, clever, and already too big by the time you name it.

pet_lamb.name: a lamb
pet_lamb.flavour: Will follow anyone with bread. Loyalty is negotiable.

pet_foal.name: a foal
pet_foal.flavour: All legs and opinions. The legs will catch up.

pet_calf.name: a calf
pet_calf.flavour: Leans on you to say hello. You will feel it tomorrow.

pet_cria.name: a llama cria
pet_cria.flavour: Long-necked and judgemental. Spits once, learns nothing.

title_mire.name: of the Mire
title_mire.flavour: The fen claims you and you have stopped arguing.

title_scarglass.name: Scarglass
title_scarglass.flavour: You brought glass up out of the dark and did not sell it.

title_measured.name: the Measured
title_measured.flavour: Weighed, counted, found exact. Nothing more, nothing less.

title_flaskcounter.name: the Flaskcounter
title_flaskcounter.flavour: The oil was all there. It usually is not.

title_nightwatch.name: of the Night Watch
title_nightwatch.flavour: Awake while the town was not.

title_mason.name: the Mason
title_mason.flavour: You set stone that is still standing.

title_miller.name: the Miller
title_miller.flavour: Flour to the elbow and an honest measure.

title_ferryman.name: the Ferryman
title_ferryman.flavour: You took people across. Some of them came back.

title_bellringer.name: the Bellringer
title_bellringer.flavour: The town hears you before it sees you.

title_returned.name: the Returned
title_returned.flavour: You came back up. That is the whole of the claim.

title_unproven.name: the Unproven
title_unproven.flavour: Nothing against you yet. Nothing for you either.

title_wardbearer.name: the Wardbearer
title_wardbearer.flavour: You carried the ward and it held.

banner_watch.name: Watch Banner (black)
banner_watch.flavour: Black, so it reads at night, which is when it matters.

banner_apothecary.name: Apothecary Banner (green)
banner_apothecary.flavour: Green with a bitter edge, like the shop.

banner_memorial.name: Memorial Banner (grey-violet)
banner_memorial.flavour: Grey-violet. Raised for the names, lowered for nothing.

banner_e3po.name: E3PO's Standard (guard blue)
banner_e3po.flavour: Guard blue, the Commander's own. It has never come down.

title_e3po_watch.name: of E3PO's Watch
title_e3po_watch.flavour: You stood a watch with the Commander and were not sent home.

title_unkillable.name: the Unkillable
title_unkillable.flavour: Said as a joke at first. Then said less as a joke.

title_second.name: the Commander's Second
title_second.flavour: He let you give an order. He did not take it back.

title_founder.name: Founder of Bellmire
title_founder.flavour: There was a crossing. Now there is a town, and your name is in it.

title_walls.name: who Walled the Town
title_walls.flavour: The wall went up on your watch.

title_ratcatcher.name: the Ratcatcher
title_ratcatcher.flavour: Unglamorous, necessary, and paid by the tail.

title_deepwarden.name: the Deepwarden
title_deepwarden.flavour: You know what is down there by name.

title_raidbreaker.name: the Raidbreaker
title_raidbreaker.flavour: A raid came to the gate and left lighter.

title_apothecary.name: the Apothecary's Friend
title_apothecary.flavour: You fetched and carried and did not ask what was in it.

title_chronicler.name: the Chronicler
title_chronicler.flavour: You wrote it down while it was still happening.

plumed_helm.name: Plumed Helm
plumed_helm.flavour: The plume costs more than the helm. Everyone knows. Everyone looks.

fisher_hood.name: Fisher's Oilskin Hood
fisher_hood.flavour: Oiled until it stands up on its own.

mourner_veil.name: Mourner's Veil
mourner_veil.flavour: Black gauze. Worn to the pit and not after.

crier_hat.name: Crier's Tall Hat
crier_hat.flavour: Tall enough to find in a crowd, which is the point.

apothecary_cap.name: Apothecary's Cap
apothecary_cap.flavour: Stained at the brim by things best not named.

drover_cap.name: Drover's Flat Cap
drover_cap.flavour: Flat, cheap, and never once lost on the road.

scarglass_circlet.name: Scarglass Circlet
scarglass_circlet.flavour: Scarglass set in iron. It catches lamplight like it remembers the dark.

commander_helm.name: Commander's Crested Helm
commander_helm.flavour: Crested in guard blue. E3PO wears one. He has not needed the crest yet.

carp_crown.name: Crown of Carp Scales
carp_crown.flavour: Scales the size of coins, off something that did not want to give them.

toll_hood.name: Toll-taker's Hood
toll_hood.flavour: Deep enough to hide a face while the hands count.

mason_dustcap.name: Mason's Dust Cap
mason_dustcap.flavour: White with stone dust before noon, every day of its life.

banner_chronicle.name: Chronicle Banner (ink)
banner_chronicle.flavour: Ink-dark. What happens under it gets written.

banner_tavern.name: Tavern Banner (ale)
banner_tavern.flavour: Ale-brown and a little sticky. Honest advertising.

banner_marketday.name: Market Day Banner (saffron)
banner_marketday.flavour: Saffron, and only out on the day. That is what makes it worth looking at.

banner_wall.name: Wall Banner (stone)
banner_wall.flavour: Stone grey. Flown the year there was finally a wall to fly it from.

banner_carp.name: Carp Banner (river-green)
banner_carp.flavour: River-green and scaled. The carp is not a joke to the fishers.

title_carpfacer.name: who Faced the Carp
title_carpfacer.flavour: You faced the carp. The fishers will not let it drop.

title_criersfav.name: the Crier's Favourite
title_criersfav.flavour: The crier says your name loudest. Make of that what you will.

title_tollbreaker.name: the Tollbreaker
title_tollbreaker.flavour: Somebody was charging. You stopped it.

title_harlsend.name: Harl's End
title_harlsend.flavour: Red Harl's road is open. You opened it.

title_weaselcatch.name: the Weasel-catcher
title_weaselcatch.flavour: The scar's edge is safe to climb out of again.

title_ashfootstill.name: who Stilled Ashfoot
title_ashfootstill.flavour: The fields stopped burning when you arrived.

title_mourner.name: the Mourner
title_mourner.flavour: You stood at the pit for someone who had nobody.

title_carter.name: the Carter
title_carter.flavour: The road and the cart, there and back, again.

title_firstwall.name: of the First Wall
title_firstwall.flavour: You were here before the stone was.

title_dyer.name: the Dyer
title_dyer.flavour: Hands permanently the wrong colour. Worth it.

title_brewer.name: the Brewer
title_brewer.flavour: The tavern's ale improved. People noticed.

title_tallykeeper.name: the Tallykeeper
title_tallykeeper.flavour: The numbers agreed. They did not before.

pet_ox.name: an ox
pet_ox.flavour: Slow, enormous, and entirely unbothered by the scar.

pet_ram.name: a ram
pet_ram.flavour: Will butt the gate until the gate loses.

pet_sow.name: a sow
pet_sow.flavour: Finds everything. Eats most of it.

pet_carthorse.name: a carthorse
pet_carthorse.flavour: Built for the road. Walks like the road owes it money.

pet_vixen.name: a vixen
pet_vixen.flavour: Silent on the stair. You will not hear her arrive.

thaw_hood.name: Thaw Hood
thaw_hood.flavour: Worn the winter the ice let go and the town did not.

rot_mask.name: Rotwarden's Mask
rot_mask.flavour: Beaked, packed with herbs. The warden's lot go in; mostly they come out.

crater_coronet.name: Crater-glass Coronet
crater_coronet.flavour: Glass off the crater floor. Few have been down to fetch it.

banner_barracks.name: Barracks Banner
banner_barracks.flavour: Hung inside, where the ones who earn it can see it.

banner_bucketline.name: Bucket-line Banner
banner_bucketline.flavour: Scorched along one edge, and left that way on purpose.

banner_thaw.name: Thaw Banner
banner_thaw.flavour: Raised the morning the ice broke and the stores held.

banner_harvest.name: Harvest-saved Banner
banner_harvest.flavour: For the year the fields came in whole despite everything.

title_thawkept.name: the Thawkept
title_thawkept.flavour: You kept the stores through to the thaw.

title_rotwarden.name: the Rotwarden
title_rotwarden.flavour: You went where the rot was and came out of it.

title_bucketline.name: of the Bucket Line
title_bucketline.flavour: You were in the line and the line did not break.

title_commanders.name: the Commander's Own
title_commanders.flavour: E3PO's own. He uses the word rarely.

title_craterwalk.name: the Crater-walker
title_craterwalk.flavour: You walked the crater floor and told the truth about it.

title_lampwright.name: the Lampwright
title_lampwright.flavour: You made the lamps that keep the street honest.

title_doorkept.name: the Doorkept
title_doorkept.flavour: Not the door held. The door kept. There is a difference.

title_coldcounted.name: the Cold-counted
title_coldcounted.flavour: You counted in the cold until the count was right.

chronicle_cap.name: Chronicler's Cap
chronicle_cap.flavour: Ink on the brim where a pen was tucked and forgotten.

ferry_hood.name: Ferryman's Hood
ferry_hood.flavour: Soaked a thousand times, dry maybe twice.

flask_coif.name: Flask-counter's Coif
flask_coif.flavour: The lamp-oil count is a dull job. The coif is the only reward.

ossuary_circlet.name: Ossuary Circlet
ossuary_circlet.flavour: Bone-pale ring, off a shelf nobody has reason to visit.

gravewyrm_helm.name: Gravewyrm Helm
gravewyrm_helm.flavour: The ridge down the crown is not decoration. It is a tooth.

pale_veil.name: Pale Veil
pale_veil.flavour: Worn by those who came up grey and stayed that way.

nightwing_hood.name: Nightwing Hood
nightwing_hood.flavour: Lined with something that still smells of the roost.

toll_cap.name: Toll-keeper's Cap
toll_cap.flavour: Says you take coin at the bridge and nothing more.

bucketline_cap.name: Bucket-line Cap
bucketline_cap.flavour: Scorched on one side. The side that faced the fire.

thaw_circlet.name: Thaw Circlet
thaw_circlet.flavour: Thin iron, worn the morning the river moved again.

memorial_veil.name: Memorial Veil
memorial_veil.flavour: Grey-violet. For the names on the stone, not the ones still walking.

architect_hat.name: Architect's Hat
architect_hat.flavour: Wide, severe, and far above your station. That is why it sells.

banner_keepdoor.name: Keep the Door Banner
banner_keepdoor.flavour: Two words, one job. The door was kept.

banner_clapper.name: Clapperless Bell Banner
banner_clapper.flavour: A bell with nothing in it. Those who know, know.

banner_architect.name: Architect's Banner
banner_architect.flavour: Severe, exact, and slightly unsettling. As intended.

banner_toll.name: Toll Banner
banner_toll.flavour: Flown over the bridge where the count is taken.

banner_crater.name: Crater Banner
banner_crater.flavour: Glass-pale. Few who fly it have been down to look.

banner_ossuary.name: Ossuary Banner
banner_ossuary.flavour: Bone white on grey. Nobody raises it twice in a year.

banner_nightwing.name: Nightwing Banner
banner_nightwing.flavour: Black, with a wing cut into it. The roost is remembered.

banner_mourncoil.name: Mourncoil Banner
banner_mourncoil.flavour: Turned, not beaten. That distinction cost lives.

banner_ferry.name: Ferry Banner
banner_ferry.flavour: Flown at the landing so the ferryman knows he is wanted.

pet_gander.name: a gander
pet_gander.flavour: Hisses at the guard. The guard gives ground.

pet_ewe.name: a yearling ewe
pet_ewe.flavour: A yearling, steady, and already wiser than the lamb.

pet_boar.name: a young boar
pet_boar.flavour: Young, tusked, and getting ideas. Keep it fed.

pet_corgi_pup.name: a corgi pup
pet_corgi_pup.flavour: Ears too big for the head. The head will catch up.

pet_mare.name: a mare
pet_mare.flavour: Steady under noise, which is rarer here than speed.

pet_heifer.name: a heifer
pet_heifer.flavour: Placid until the gate is open, then astonishingly quick.

pet_cub.name: a fox cub
pet_cub.flavour: Sleeps in your pack. Wakes in your rations.

title_clapperless.name: the Clapperless
title_clapperless.flavour: The bell was silent and you rang it anyway.

title_architects_toy.name: the Architect's Toy
title_architects_toy.flavour: His word, not yours. He meant it kindly. Probably.

title_keptflask.name: Keeper of Flasks
title_keptflask.flavour: The flasks were all accounted for. Every time.

title_tollpaid.name: Toll-paid
title_tollpaid.flavour: You paid and crossed. Honest, cheap, unremarkable.

title_ossuary.name: of the Ossuary
title_ossuary.flavour: You have been on the shelf-side of that door.

title_gravewyrm.name: Gravewyrm-faced
title_gravewyrm.flavour: You looked at it. It looked back. Only one of you left whole.

title_duchess.name: Favoured of the Duchess
title_duchess.flavour: Favoured, and nobody is entirely comfortable about it.

title_nightwing.name: Nightwing-marked
title_nightwing.flavour: Marked by the roost. It does not wash off.

title_hollow.name: Hollow-crowned
title_hollow.flavour: A crown with nothing under it. You wear it anyway.

title_wallbreaker.name: Wallbreaker
title_wallbreaker.flavour: Something had a wall. It does not now.

title_hostscatter.name: Host-scatterer
title_hostscatter.flavour: The host came on together and left in pieces.

title_mourncoil.name: Mourncoil-turned
title_mourncoil.flavour: Turned, not beaten. Ask anyone who was there.

title_twicecount.name: Twice Counted
title_twicecount.flavour: You counted it twice. The second count is the one that mattered.

title_doorward.name: Doorward
title_doorward.flavour: Posted at the door, and still there at dawn.

title_unmeasured.name: the Unmeasured
title_unmeasured.flavour: Nobody has worked you out yet.

title_latetoford.name: Late to the Ford
title_latetoford.flavour: Late, every time, and somehow forgiven.

lampwright_cap.name: Lampwright's Cap
lampwright_cap.flavour: Smells faintly of oil. It always will.

quarry_helm.name: Quarryman's Helm
quarry_helm.flavour: Chipped where the stone came down and the man did not.

crier_plume.name: Crier's Plume
crier_plume.flavour: A plume for the second-loudest voice in Bellmire.

fen_hood.name: Fenwalker's Hood
fen_hood.flavour: Green-stained to the shoulder. The fen marks its own.

host_coif.name: Rattling Coif
host_coif.flavour: Rattles when you move. So did what it came off.

banner_lamplight.name: Lamplight Banner (amber)
banner_lamplight.flavour: Amber. Up at dusk with the first lamp, down with the last.

banner_quarry.name: Quarry Banner (slate)
banner_quarry.flavour: Slate grey, always a little dusty.

banner_grubmother.name: Grubmother Banner (pale)
banner_grubmother.flavour: Pale, and not pleasant to look at long.

title_fenwalker.name: the Fenwalker
title_fenwalker.flavour: You know which ground holds. Most do not.

title_quarried.name: the Quarried
title_quarried.flavour: Stone dust in the lungs and a town built out of it.

title_hostsilenced.name: who Silenced the Host
title_hostsilenced.flavour: The rattling stopped. You stopped it.

chalk_cap.name: Chalker's Cap
chalk_cap.flavour: White handprints on the crown. The chalker's own.

stairhold_helm.name: Stairholder's Helm
stairhold_helm.flavour: Battered on the front only. He never turned round.

mender_coif.name: Mender's Coif
mender_coif.flavour: Clean linen, kept clean. A mender who is filthy is no mender.

pitwalk_hood.name: Pitwalker's Hood
pitwalk_hood.flavour: Weighted at the hem so the draught does not lift it.

banner_stair.name: Stairhold Banner (grey-blue)
banner_stair.flavour: Grey-blue. For the stair that was held when it should not have been.

banner_chalk.name: Chalkline Banner (white)
banner_chalk.flavour: White, marked in lines. The chalker's count, flown.

banner_mender.name: Menders' Banner (pale green)
banner_mender.flavour: Pale green, clean. Menders insist on the clean.

title_stairheld.name: who Held the Stair
title_stairheld.flavour: You stood on the stair while everyone else went up it.

title_chalker.name: the Chalker
title_chalker.flavour: Your lines on the wall told people where to stand.

title_secondflask.name: of the Second Flask
title_secondflask.flavour: There was one flask left. You gave it away.

title_lastup.name: Last Up the Stair
title_lastup.flavour: Last up the stair. Everybody else was already out.

title_pitwalker.name: the Pitwalker
title_pitwalker.flavour: Down into the pit on purpose, and back out the same way.

title_mender.name: the Mender
title_mender.flavour: You put people back together where they fell.

title_countedback.name: Counted Back
title_countedback.flavour: They counted you out. The count was wrong.

tithe_cap.name: Tithe Cap
tithe_cap.flavour: Wax-white. Worn the one day a year nobody argues about the count.

saltline_hood.name: Saltline Hood
saltline_hood.flavour: Stiff with salt, pale at every fold.

watchfire_helm.name: Watchfire Helm
watchfire_helm.flavour: The ember-scorch on the crown was earned in one night.

cartwright_cap.name: Cartwright's Cap
cartwright_cap.flavour: Sawdust in the lining. Smells better than most hats.

wakeward_veil.name: Wake-ward Veil
wakeward_veil.flavour: For sitting up with the dead until morning. Slate, not black.

fogrun_hood.name: Fog-run Hood
fogrun_hood.flavour: Pale grey. Worn by whoever carried word through the fog and arrived.

ninthbell_coif.name: Ninth Bell Coif
ninthbell_coif.flavour: Home by the ninth bell, every night, or do not wear it.

ropeburn_cap.name: Rope-burn Cap
ropeburn_cap.flavour: A rope ran through the brim once, fast.

firstlight_circlet.name: First Light Circlet
firstlight_circlet.flavour: Given to the first up the wall at dawn. Rarely twice to one head.

longcount_hood.name: Long Count Hood
longcount_hood.flavour: Deep, dull, patient. For the count that takes all night.

coldforge_mask.name: Cold-forge Mask
coldforge_mask.flavour: Char on the face plate, off a forge that was never lit warm.

kindling_crown.name: Kindling Crown
kindling_crown.flavour: Gilt the colour of the first beam of a saved morning.

banner_tithe.name: Tithe Banner (wax-white)
banner_tithe.flavour: Wax-white. One day a year it means something.

banner_saltline.name: Saltline Banner (pale blue)
banner_saltline.flavour: Pale blue, stiff at the hem with salt.

banner_wakeward.name: Wake-ward Banner (slate)
banner_wakeward.flavour: Slate. Hung at a door where someone sat up all night.

banner_fogrun.name: Fog-run Banner (fog)
banner_fogrun.flavour: Fog-grey, hard to see, which is the joke.

banner_ninthbell.name: Ninth Bell Banner (bronze)
banner_ninthbell.flavour: Bronze. Home by the ninth, or explain yourself.

banner_longcount.name: Long Count Banner (iron)
banner_longcount.flavour: Iron-dull. For the count that runs past midnight.

banner_coldforge.name: Cold-forge Banner (char)
banner_coldforge.flavour: Char-black. A forge gone cold is a bad sign, and this says so.

banner_kindling.name: Kindling Banner (first-beam gold)
banner_kindling.flavour: First-beam gold. The colour of a morning the town earned.

banner_ropeworks.name: Ropeworks Banner (hemp)
banner_ropeworks.flavour: Hemp-brown, frayed at the fly. Fitting.

title_tithed.name: who Paid the Tithe
title_tithed.flavour: You paid the tithe in full and did not complain about it.

title_saltline.name: of the Saltline
title_saltline.flavour: You held the saltline when the pans were all the town had.

title_watchfire.name: who Lit the Watchfire
title_watchfire.flavour: You lit it. The valley saw it. The valley came.

title_ninthbell.name: Home by the Ninth Bell
title_ninthbell.flavour: Home by the ninth bell, every night, for a year.

title_fogrun.name: the Fog-runner
title_fogrun.flavour: You carried word through the fog and arrived in time.

title_wakeward.name: who Sat Up
title_wakeward.flavour: You sat up with the dead so somebody would.

title_ropeburn.name: Rope-burned
title_ropeburn.flavour: The rope ran through your hands and you did not let go.

title_coldforge.name: of the Cold Forge
title_coldforge.flavour: You worked the forge the winter it would not stay lit.

title_longcount.name: the Long Count
title_longcount.flavour: The count ran all night. So did you.

title_firstlight.name: First on the Wall
title_firstlight.flavour: First on the wall at first light. Others came after.

title_kindling.name: who Kept the Beam Warm
title_kindling.flavour: You kept the beam warm until morning came for it.

title_cartwright.name: the Cartwright
title_cartwright.flavour: Wheels that are still round. A short list.

title_splintwrap.name: Two Fingers of Cane
title_splintwrap.flavour: Two fingers of cane, and back to work.

title_mudplank.name: Flat-footed in the Fen
title_mudplank.flavour: Flat-footed in the fen and never once drowned.

title_lastcoin.name: who Spent the Last Coin
title_lastcoin.flavour: You spent the last coin on somebody else.

title_grainward.name: Grainward
title_grainward.flavour: The grain was there in spring because you watched it in autumn.

title_oathwrong.name: Wrong Hand, Right Oath
title_oathwrong.flavour: Wrong hand on the stone, right words out of the mouth.

thatcher_cap.name: Thatcher's Cap
thatcher_cap.flavour: Reed-straw, tied, replaced every season. Cheap as the trade.

glazier_visor.name: Glazier's Visor
glazier_visor.flavour: Smoked glass. You stop seeing the furnace and start seeing the work.

pilgrim_hood.name: Pilgrim's Hood
pilgrim_hood.flavour: Road dust in the weave, off somewhere further than the Ford.

votive_veil.name: Votive Veil
votive_veil.flavour: Wax-spotted at the hem by a hundred small flames.

crane_helm.name: Cranesman's Helm
crane_helm.flavour: Steel over the ears, for working under a load that does not forgive.

towpath_hood.name: Towpath Hood
towpath_hood.flavour: Bank-green, rubbed bald at the shoulder by the rope.

bellfounder_coif.name: Bellfounder's Coif
bellfounder_coif.flavour: Bronze-flecked. He stood close when it poured.

quarry_cap.name: Quarryman's Cap
quarry_cap.flavour: Dust-grey and gritty. It will never be any other colour.

ferrybell_circlet.name: Ferrybell Circlet
ferrybell_circlet.flavour: Worn by whoever rings the ferry in. The river is not patient.

banner_thatch.name: Thatchers' Banner (reed gold)
banner_thatch.flavour: Reed gold. Replaced every season, like the roofs.

banner_glazier.name: Glaziers' Banner (glass blue)
banner_glazier.flavour: Glass blue, and it catches the light the way the trade does.

banner_pilgrim.name: Pilgrims' Banner (road brown)
banner_pilgrim.flavour: Road brown. Carried further than most banners ever go.

banner_crane.name: Cranesmen's Banner (rope grey)
banner_crane.flavour: Rope grey. Flown where loads go up and people stand under them.

banner_paver.name: Pavers' Banner (stone)
banner_paver.flavour: Stone grey, laid flat in the weave like the road itself.

banner_towpath.name: Towpath Banner (bank green)
banner_towpath.flavour: Bank green, worn through where the rope crosses.

banner_bellfounder.name: Bellfounders' Banner (bronze)
banner_bellfounder.flavour: Bronze. The trade that makes the town's loudest voice.

banner_quarryman.name: Quarrymen's Banner (dust)
banner_quarryman.flavour: Dust pale. It is the same colour as everyone under it.

title_thatcher.name: the Thatcher
title_thatcher.flavour: Roofs that kept the rain out all season.

title_glazier.name: the Glazier
title_glazier.flavour: Glass in the windows, and the town suddenly looks richer.

title_pilgrim.name: who Walked It Twice
title_pilgrim.flavour: You walked the road twice. Nobody asked you to.

title_votive.name: who Lit the Votive
title_votive.flavour: A small flame, lit on purpose, for somebody else.

title_crane.name: of the Crane
title_crane.flavour: You worked under the load and trusted the rope.

title_paver.name: who Laid the Road
title_paver.flavour: The road is flat because you made it flat.

title_towpath.name: off the Towpath
title_towpath.flavour: Off the towpath and into the water, at least once.

title_bellfounder.name: the Bellfounder
title_bellfounder.flavour: You poured the bell the town answers to.

title_quarryman.name: the Quarryman
title_quarryman.flavour: The stone came out. You were the reason.

title_ferrybell.name: who Rang for the Ferry
title_ferrybell.flavour: You rang, and the river answered. Eventually.

title_weighstone.name: Weighed and Found Heavy
title_weighstone.flavour: Weighed and found heavy. The good kind.

title_ropewalk.name: the Ropewalker
title_ropewalk.flavour: A hundred fathoms, walked backwards, every day.

cooper_cap.name: Cooper's Cap
cooper_cap.flavour: Smells of oak and wet hoop-iron.

orchard_straw.name: Orchard Straw Hat
orchard_straw.flavour: Wide brim, cider-stained at the band.

reeve_hat.name: Reeve's Hat
reeve_hat.flavour: Says the count was taken, and the count was his.

collier_hood.name: Collier's Hood
collier_hood.flavour: Black at every seam. Washing only moves it around.

shepherd_hood.name: Shepherd's Hood
shepherd_hood.flavour: Lanolin-soft. Rain sits on it and gives up.

wellkeep_coif.name: Wellkeeper's Coif
wellkeep_coif.flavour: Damp at the brow. It is always damp at the brow.

winterwatch_helm.name: Winterwatch Helm
winterwatch_helm.flavour: Fleece-lined steel. The watch does not stop for frost.

saltboiler_cap.name: Saltboiler's Cap
saltboiler_cap.flavour: Bleached pale by steam off the pans.

banner_cooper.name: Cooper's Banner
banner_cooper.flavour: Oak brown, hooped in iron on the device.

banner_orchard.name: Orchard Banner
banner_orchard.flavour: Blossom on one side, cider on the other.

banner_reeve.name: Reeve's Banner
banner_reeve.flavour: Flown where the count is taken and argued with.

banner_collier.name: Collier's Banner
banner_collier.flavour: Black, honestly earned, impossible to clean.

banner_wellhead.name: Wellhead Banner
banner_wellhead.flavour: Flown over the well. Water is the first thing a siege wants.

banner_winterwatch.name: Winterwatch Banner
banner_winterwatch.flavour: Frost-pale. Up from first frost to thaw, no exceptions.

banner_saltline_works.name: Saltworks Banner
banner_saltline_works.flavour: Pale as the pans and twice as stiff.

pet_llama_full.name: a full-grown llama
pet_llama_full.flavour: Stands guard over smaller animals without being asked.

pet_wether.name: a wether
pet_wether.flavour: Even-tempered, and surprisingly good company on a road.

pet_bullock.name: a bullock
pet_bullock.flavour: Strong, young, and not yet aware of it.

pet_duckling.name: a duckling
pet_duckling.flavour: Cheapest thing on the shelf, and the one people point at.

pet_colt.name: a colt
pet_colt.flavour: Faster than it can steer. Give it a year.

pet_dogfox.name: a dog fox
pet_dogfox.flavour: Keeps its distance, then sleeps against your back.

title_cooper.name: the Cooper's Friend
title_cooper.flavour: Barrels that hold. The cooper remembers who helped.

title_orchard.name: of the Orchard
title_orchard.flavour: Cider in autumn, and you were up the trees for it.

title_reeve.name: Counted by the Reeve
title_reeve.flavour: Counted by the reeve and still standing afterwards.

title_collier.name: the Collier
title_collier.flavour: Black to the wrist and warm all winter for it.

title_shepherd.name: the Shepherd
title_shepherd.flavour: You brought them all down off the hill. All of them.

title_wellhead.name: who Went Down the Well
title_wellhead.flavour: Somebody had to go down the well. It was you.

title_winterwatch.name: of the Winter Watch
title_winterwatch.flavour: You stood the frost watches nobody volunteers for.

title_saltboiler.name: the Saltboiler
title_saltboiler.flavour: Steam-bleached and steady at the pans.

title_hedgeward.name: the Hedgeward
title_hedgeward.flavour: The hedge held because you laid it right.

title_wheelwright.name: the Wheelwright
title_wheelwright.flavour: Spokes true, rims tight, road survived.

title_netmender.name: the Netmender
title_netmender.flavour: The catch came in because the net did not go out torn.

title_hayward.name: the Hayward
title_hayward.flavour: Fences kept, beasts in, fields whole.

title_tinker.name: the Tinker
title_tinker.flavour: You mend what the town would otherwise throw away.

title_threshed.name: Threshed and Still Standing
title_threshed.flavour: Threshed and still standing. Said of very few.

tanner_cap.name: Tanner's Cap
tanner_cap.flavour: You will smell the trade before you see the cap.

fletcher_hood.name: Fletcher's Hood
fletcher_hood.flavour: Goose-grey, with a down feather caught in the stitching.

farrier_visor.name: Farrier's Visor
farrier_visor.flavour: Scarred by sparks on the one side a hoof does not cover.

sexton_hat.name: Sexton's Low Hat
sexton_hat.flavour: Low, black, and never once taken off at the pit.

skep_veil.name: Skepward's Veil
skep_veil.flavour: Fine mesh. Sixty stings taught the trade this much.

lockkeep_cap.name: Lockkeeper's Cap
lockkeep_cap.flavour: Weir-green, soaked to the band most mornings.

fuller_coif.name: Fuller's Coif
fuller_coif.flavour: Cloth-white and faintly sour. The trade's own perfume.

bowyer_cap.name: Bowyer's Cap
bowyer_cap.flavour: A shaving of yew tucked behind the ear, always.

currier_hood.name: Currier's Hood
currier_hood.flavour: Oiled like the hides. It has outlasted three owners.

banner_tanner.name: Tanners' Banner (hide brown)
banner_tanner.flavour: Hide brown. Hung downwind, by long agreement.

banner_fuller.name: Fullers' Banner (cloth white)
banner_fuller.flavour: Cloth white. The cleanest banner in a filthy trade.

banner_fletcher.name: Fletchers' Banner (goose grey)
banner_fletcher.flavour: Goose grey, with three feathers in the device.

banner_farrier.name: Farriers' Banner (anvil black)
banner_farrier.flavour: Anvil black. Heavy-looking, as it should be.

banner_potter.name: Potters' Banner (kiln red)
banner_potter.flavour: Kiln red. The colour the trade turns everything.

banner_sexton.name: Sexton's Banner (grave black)
banner_sexton.flavour: Grave black, and plainer than anything else on the row.

banner_skep.name: Skepwards' Banner (wax gold)
banner_skep.flavour: Wax gold, with a skep stitched small and neat.

banner_lockkeep.name: Lockkeepers' Banner (weir green)
banner_lockkeep.flavour: Weir green. Flown where the water is told what to do.

title_tanner.name: the Tanner
title_tanner.flavour: The trade nobody stands near and everybody needs.

title_fuller.name: the Fuller
title_fuller.flavour: Cloth in, cloth out, sour hands forever.

title_fletcher.name: the Fletcher
title_fletcher.flavour: Straight shafts, true feathers, and a garrison that can shoot.

title_farrier.name: the Farrier
title_farrier.flavour: Shoes on, horse calm, nobody kicked.

title_potter.name: the Potter
title_potter.flavour: Clay to cup, and the cup does not leak.

title_sexton.name: the Sexton
title_sexton.flavour: You dug it, filled it, and said the words.

title_skepward.name: the Skepward
title_skepward.flavour: Stung a thousand times for the town's honey.

title_lockkeeper.name: the Lockkeeper
title_lockkeeper.flavour: The weir does what you tell it.

title_tanyard.name: who Stood in the Tanyard
title_tanyard.flavour: You stood in the tanyard a full day. Not many ask twice.

title_strungwet.name: who Strung It Wet
title_strungwet.flavour: You strung it wet and it still loosed true.

title_shodit.name: who Shod the Charger
title_shodit.flavour: You shod the charger. It did not care for the idea.

title_heldtheweir.name: who Held the Weir
title_heldtheweir.flavour: The water came up. The weir did not go.

shop_stock._note_tier: Each entry also carries "tier": the growth tier at which this good first appears on a shelf, 1-12, matching lore_lines.growth_tiers. It is the SAME gate as stock_by_tier.shop_adds (the two are generated together and must agree) - this key is here so a shop can filter its own stock with good.tier <= town_tier instead of building a reverse map. Cumulative: a tier-N shop shows every good with tier <= N. Added C-cycle 7.
shop_stock._note: Shop display stock (D35/D39) - everyday goods a shop shows on its shelves. Keyed {name,cost,flavour} like the rest of the file. Dead until wired.

grain.name: Sack of Grain
grain.flavour: Measured, counted, sold by the sack.

lampoil.name: Flask of Oil
lampoil.flavour: For the lamps. Count them twice.

ale.name: Jug of Ale
ale.flavour: The tavern's own. Cloudy and honest.

wool.name: Bolt of Wool
wool.flavour: Grey, like everything the guild wears.

nails.name: Keg of Nails
nails.flavour: The masons buy them by the keg.

hooks.name: Fishhooks
hooks.flavour: For the river. Mind the Grinning Carp.

lantern.name: Tin Lantern
lantern.flavour: Keeps a flame in the wind off the scar.

firewood.name: Cord of Firewood
firewood.flavour: Split, stacked, and sold before the frost.

fish.name: String of River Fish
fish.flavour: Caught above the ford, where the water still runs clean.

cheese.name: Round of Cheese
cheese.flavour: Hard, pale, keeps a month in a cold room.

whetstone.name: Whetstone
whetstone.flavour: A blade is only as sharp as the last man who sat down with this.

blanket.name: Wool Blanket
blanket.flavour: Grey. Heavy. Worth every coin in the second week of winter.

pottery.name: Stack of Crockery
pottery.flavour: Fired at Craft Row. Chipped before it reaches the table.

boots.name: Pair of Boots
boots.flavour: Cobbled for the mire, not for the dance floor.

ink.name: Pot of Ink
ink.flavour: Oak gall and soot. The Chronicle drinks it by the pot.

parchment.name: Sheaf of Parchment
parchment.flavour: Scraped thin. A name fits on a very small piece.

leather.name: Hide of Leather
leather.flavour: Tanned on the downwind side of town, for good reason.

arrows.name: Sheaf of Arrows
arrows.flavour: Twenty-four, fletched grey. The garrison counts them back.

shield.name: Plain Shield
shield.flavour: Lime-wood, hide rim, no device. Devices get you noticed.

spice_twist.name: Twist of Spice
spice_twist.flavour: A thimble of somewhere warmer, sold by the thimble.

sweets.name: Box of Sugared Peel
sweets.flavour: Market-day money, gone by market-day dusk.

glass_pane.name: Pane of Glass
glass_pane.flavour: A window instead of a shutter. That is what a wall buys you.

physic.name: Apothecary's Physic
physic.flavour: Measured, corked, and written down in her ledger.

mirror.name: Hand Mirror
mirror.flavour: Polished tin. Bellmire can finally afford to look at itself.

sandglass.name: Sand-glass
sandglass.flavour: The hour, in a bottle. The guild has opinions about the hour now.

silk_kerchief.name: Silk Kerchief
silk_kerchief.flavour: Sold a square at a time, to people who were lately peasants.

eggs.name: Basket of Eggs
eggs.flavour: Still warm. Count them before you pay.

waterskin.name: Waterskin
waterskin.flavour: Filled above the ford. Below it, you would not.

butter.name: Crock of Butter
butter.flavour: Churned this morning, gone by this evening.

net.name: Fishing Net
net.flavour: Mended more times than it was ever woven.

tallow.name: Tub of Tallow
tallow.flavour: Lamp fat. Burns dirty, burns cheap, burns.

sealing_wax.name: Block of Sealing Wax
sealing_wax.flavour: The guild post has a door, and the door has letters.

preserves.name: Jar of Preserves
preserves.flavour: Last summer in a jar, kept for the worst of the winter.

besom.name: Besom Broom
besom.flavour: Twigs and twine. Every doorway in Bellmire owns one.

ribbon.name: Reel of Ribbon
ribbon.flavour: Market-day colour, and the first thing bought with a girl's own coin.

handscales.name: Hand Scales
handscales.flavour: Brass pans, honest beam. Measure the grain.

mourning_cloth.name: Length of Mourning Cloth
mourning_cloth.flavour: Sold by the yard. The chapel keeps a stock. So does the mason.

psalter.name: Chapel Psalter
psalter.flavour: Copied by hand. The bell has no clapper, so the book does the singing.

bellows.name: Hand Bellows
bellows.flavour: Leather and ash-wood. A forge is a fire somebody keeps breathing.

hide_glue.name: Pot of Hide Glue
hide_glue.flavour: Smells like the tannery, because it is the tannery.

smith_file.name: Smith's File
smith_file.flavour: Cuts iron slowly, which is the only way iron is cut.

helm.name: Plain Helm
helm.flavour: Garrison issue, unpainted. The dents come free.

bowstrings.name: Spare Bowstrings
bowstrings.flavour: Waxed, coiled, three to a packet. The wet eats the first.

soap.name: Cake of Scented Soap
soap.flavour: A market town can afford to smell like something other than a market.

figs.name: Box of Dried Figs
figs.flavour: Came up the road in a crate stamped in a language nobody here reads.

lock.name: Iron Lock and Key
lock.flavour: A wall is only a wall if the gate shuts. Same goes for a door.

mortar.name: Barrel of Mortar
mortar.flavour: Lime, sand, and the reason the first wall is still standing.

brass_lamp.name: Brass Lamp
brass_lamp.flavour: Hangs in a hall, not on a pole. The lamplighters sniff at it.

spectacles.name: Pair of Spectacles
spectacles.flavour: Two ground lenses in wire. The Chronicle's scribe wept.

pepper.name: Pepper Mill
pepper.flavour: Ground at the table, in front of guests. That is the entire point.

carpet.name: Patterned Carpet
carpet.flavour: Woven somewhere with no mire in it. Wipe your boots.

altar_oil.name: Flask of Altar Oil
altar_oil.flavour: Burns clear and slow. The chapel will not sell you the cheap stuff.

oilcloth.name: Oilcloth Cape
oilcloth.flavour: Keeps a bowstring dry, which keeps an archer useful.

comb.name: Bone Comb
comb.flavour: Carved at the stall while you wait. Mind the teeth.

iron_hinges.name: Set of Iron Hinges
iron_hinges.flavour: A gate is two hinges and an argument about who shuts it.

pewter_set.name: Pewter Table Set
pewter_set.flavour: Plates that match. Bellmire has opinions about plates that match.

glass_goblets.name: Pair of Glass Goblets
glass_goblets.flavour: Drinking from glass, in a town that drank from horn a lifetime ago.

clay_cups.name: Clay Cups
clay_cups.flavour: Thrown wet, dried in the sun, chipped by Thursday.

onions.name: Rope of Onions
onions.flavour: Hung from a beam until wanted. The whole hut smells of them.

straw.name: Bale of Straw
straw.flavour: Bedding for the beast, and for whoever lost the argument.

milk.name: Pail of Milk
milk.flavour: Carried up from the pen without spilling, which is the whole trick.

honey.name: Pot of Honey
honey.flavour: Robbed from the skeps by the well. Worth the stings.

flax.name: Bundle of Flax
flax.flavour: Retted in the river, spun by the fire, worn until it falls off.

ledger.name: Guild Ledger
ledger.flavour: Ruled, bound, and feared. The post keeps everything in it.

pitch.name: Bucket of Pitch
pitch.flavour: Seals a roof, a boot, or a boat. Mostly the boot.

lamp_wick.name: Reel of Lamp Wick
lamp_wick.flavour: Cut to length by the lamplighter, who has opinions about length.

bacon.name: Flitch of Bacon
bacon.flavour: Smoked in the rafters since autumn. Counted by the slice.

shears.name: Pair of Shears
shears.flavour: Sheep first, hair second, and nobody washes them between.

vinegar.name: Jug of Vinegar
vinegar.flavour: For the pickling and for the wound. Same jug, different day.

tally_sticks.name: Bundle of Tally Sticks
tally_sticks.flavour: Split, notched, and matched. A promise you cannot argue with.

stall_canvas.name: Stall Canvas
stall_canvas.flavour: Market-day roof. Sheds rain, not gossip.

bell_rope.name: Bell Rope
bell_rope.flavour: The bell has no clapper. They pull it anyway, and the town stands up.

grave_marker.name: Carved Grave Marker
grave_marker.flavour: The mason cuts the name and leaves the date to the scar.

censer.name: Brass Censer
censer.flavour: Swung slow. Smoke covers a great deal.

pit_saw.name: Two-Man Pit Saw
pit_saw.flavour: Takes two men to use and three to argue about.

potters_clay.name: Load of Potter's Clay
potters_clay.flavour: Dug from the riverbank, trodden barefoot, fired at the Row.

forge_apron.name: Leather Forge Apron
forge_apron.flavour: Scorched in the shape of its last owner.

watch_horn.name: Watch Horn
watch_horn.flavour: One blast for raiders, two for fire. Three and you run.

caltrops.name: Bag of Caltrops
caltrops.flavour: Scattered at dusk, gathered at dawn, counted both times.

field_bandages.name: Roll of Field Bandages
field_bandages.flavour: The garrison buys them by the roll and still runs short.

almonds.name: Sack of Sugared Almonds
almonds.flavour: Came up the road with the figs and twice the price.

dyed_sash.name: Dyed Sash
dyed_sash.flavour: Colour a labourer can afford, worn where it shows.

door_bar.name: Oak Door Bar
door_bar.flavour: A wall is a rumour until something drops into the brackets.

gate_tar.name: Barrel of Gate Tar
gate_tar.flavour: Painted on the gate each spring. It stinks, and the gate lasts.

street_lamp.name: Iron Street Lamp
street_lamp.flavour: Set along the wall road. The lamplighters drank to it for a week.

writing_desk.name: Folding Writing Desk
writing_desk.flavour: Travels with the guild's clerk and outranks him.

kid_gloves.name: Pair of Kid Gloves
kid_gloves.flavour: Thin enough to feel a coin through. That is the point.

apothecary_jar.name: Apothecary Jar
apothecary_jar.flavour: Lidded, labelled, and not to be opened by the curious.

lute.name: Painted Lute
lute.flavour: Bought by a man who fully intends to learn.

tapestry.name: Wall Tapestry
tapestry.flavour: A hunt nobody here has ever been on, hung where guests must pass.

reed_thatch.name: Bundle of Thatch
reed_thatch.flavour: Reed off the fen, cut short and bound tight. Every roof here starts as this.

clay_pot.name: Clay Cooking Pot
clay_pot.flavour: Fired brown, mended once already. It will outlive the cookfire.

laying_hen.name: A Laying Hen
laying_hen.flavour: Sold with her character described honestly, which is rare in a market.

sack_beans.name: Sack of Beans
sack_beans.flavour: What a household eats in the weeks the grain does not stretch.

guild_chit.name: Guild Chit
guild_chit.flavour: Brass, stamped with the post's mark. It means somebody vouched for you.

leather_awl.name: Leather Awl
leather_awl.flavour: Bone handle, worn to a thumbprint. A post without one mends nothing.

iron_spade.name: Iron Spade
iron_spade.flavour: A village is a place with enough spades to dig and bury in the same week.

beeswax_cake.name: Cake of Beeswax
beeswax_cake.flavour: For thread, for boots, for the chapel. Nothing here is wasted twice.

market_weight.name: Market Weight
market_weight.flavour: True to the grain and stamped to prove it. The stall that fakes one closes.

stall_bell.name: Stall Bell
stall_bell.flavour: Rung to open, rung to close. In between it is rung for the sheer joy of it.

votive_candle.name: Votive Candle
votive_candle.flavour: Lit for a name. The chapel keeps the names; the candle only keeps the hour.

prayer_beads.name: String of Beads
prayer_beads.flavour: Pear-wood, counted smooth. Most of the counting was done waiting on news.

rivet_box.name: Box of Rivets
rivet_box.flavour: Craft Row runs on these and on nobody admitting how often one fails.

glue_pot.name: Glue Pot
glue_pot.flavour: Kept warm all day. The smell is the price of everything else on the Row.

guard_whistle.name: Guard's Whistle
guard_whistle.flavour: One blast is a question. Two is the wall. Nobody blows three twice.

drill_pike.name: Drill Pike
drill_pike.flavour: Blunted on purpose. The Commander insists the drill hurt only a little.

ginger_knob.name: Knob of Ginger
ginger_knob.flavour: Came upriver in a crate that cost more than the cart. A market town smells of it.

sealed_crock.name: Sealed Crock
sealed_crock.flavour: Waxed shut. Whatever is inside keeps a season, which is the whole trick.

wall_chalk.name: Box of Wall-chalk
wall_chalk.flavour: For marking the courses, and for the names somebody adds at the end of a shift.

crane_rope.name: Crane Rope
crane_rope.flavour: Three-strand, tested to a weight nobody wants to see it hold.

paving_maul.name: Paving Maul
paving_maul.flavour: A town with paved streets is a town that stopped expecting to move.

shutter_lock.name: Shutter Lock
shutter_lock.flavour: Sold briskly ever since the walls went up and people found new things to fear.

pomander.name: Pomander
pomander.flavour: Cloves in a silver cage, carried by people who can afford to dislike the smell.

gilt_frame.name: Gilt Frame
gilt_frame.flavour: Empty. The buyer has a face in mind and will not say whose.

trader_cargo._note_tier: Each entry also carries "tier": the growth tier at which a caravan first hauls this cargo, 1-12, matching lore_lines.growth_tiers. Same gate as stock_by_tier.cargo_adds (generated together, must agree) - here so a caravan can be loaded with cargo.tier <= town_tier without a reverse map. Cumulative. A tier-1 crossing has no caravans at all. Added C-cycle 7.
trader_cargo._note: Trader caravan cargo (D35/D39) - what a caravan carries and what bandits want. Higher value, worth losing. Keyed {name,cost,flavour}. Dead until wired.

spice.name: Crate of Spice
spice.flavour: From downriver. Smells of somewhere warmer than here.

pigiron.name: Pig Iron
pigiron.flavour: Bar stock for the smiths. Heavy, dull, wanted.

silk.name: Bale of Silk
silk.flavour: Too fine for Bellmire, which is exactly why it sells.

wine.name: Cask of Wine
wine.flavour: The real stuff, not the tavern's.

saltblock.name: Block of Salt
saltblock.flavour: A caravan's fortune in one white brick.

simples.name: Chest of Simples
simples.flavour: The apothecary's standing order. Guard it.

timber.name: Load of Seasoned Timber
timber.flavour: Good beams - the kind the masons cannot cut fast enough.

furs.name: Pack of Furs
furs.flavour: From the high country. Warm, and worth a raid.

scarglass.name: Crate of Scarglass
scarglass.flavour: Hauled up from below and sold above. Only slightly cursed.

seedcorn.name: Sacks of Seed Corn
seedcorn.flavour: Next year's bread, riding in this year's cart.

incense.name: Casket of Incense
incense.flavour: For the chapel. It makes the scar smell like somewhere holy.

tools.name: Crate of Fine Tools
tools.flavour: Chisels, files, calipers. A craft row cannot be built by hand.

copperware.name: Crate of Copperware
copperware.flavour: Pots that outlive the cook. Bandits know it too.

steelbar.name: Bundle of Steel Bar
steelbar.flavour: Proper steel, not bog iron. The garrison has first claim.

warhorses.name: String of Warhorses
warhorses.flavour: Four of them, led not ridden. Worth more than the cart and crew.

dyestuff.name: Barrel of Dyestuff
dyestuff.flavour: Woad and madder. Colour is the first luxury a town buys.

books.name: Chest of Books
books.flavour: Twelve of them. More words than most of Bellmire has ever seen.

charcoal.name: Load of Charcoal
charcoal.flavour: Burnt slow in the hills and hauled down by the sack. The forge eats it.

rawhides.name: Bundle of Raw Hides
rawhides.flavour: Still smelling of the beast. The tanner pays before he looks.

oiljars.name: Jars of Lamp Oil
oiljars.flavour: Forty jars, straw-packed. One broken jar can take the whole cart.

chapel_plate.name: Case of Chapel Plate
chapel_plate.flavour: Silver for the altar. Bandits are not particular about blessings.

candlewax.name: Barrels of Beeswax
candlewax.flavour: Chapel grade - the only candle that does not smell of the kill.

millstones.name: Pair of Millstones
millstones.flavour: Two tons of cut grit. Nobody steals these; they just stop the cart.

mail_shirts.name: Bundle of Mail Shirts
mail_shirts.flavour: Riveted, oiled, rolled in sacking. The garrison counts the rings.

sugarloaf.name: Loaves of Sugar
sugarloaf.flavour: White, hard, and worth a knife shaped for nothing else.

parchment_bales.name: Bales of Parchment
parchment_bales.flavour: The Chronicle's standing order, and the scribes' whole year.

cut_stone.name: Wagon of Cut Stone
cut_stone.flavour: Squared at the quarry. A wall is paid for one wagon at a time.

mirrorglass.name: Crate of Mirror Glass
mirrorglass.flavour: Packed face to face. Seven years of bad luck a sheet.

goldwork.name: Casket of Goldwork
goldwork.flavour: Chains, clasps, and a coronet nobody in Bellmire has the neck for.

salt_fish.name: Barrels of Salt Fish
salt_fish.flavour: Downriver catch in brine. It outlasts the winter and the appetite.

lime.name: Casks of Quicklime
lime.flavour: For the mortar. It burns the hands of anyone who hurries.

spiced_wine.name: Butts of Spiced Wine
spiced_wine.flavour: Brought up for the guild's table and guarded like the guild's gold.

plough_irons.name: Crate of Plough Irons
plough_irons.flavour: Share and coulter, carted in. The wood is local; the iron never is.

wheel_rims.name: Bundle of Wheel Rims
wheel_rims.flavour: Iron hoops for the wheelwright. A cart is mostly other people's work.

tanbark.name: Load of Tanbark
tanbark.flavour: Oak bark for the tannery. Cheap to steal, miserable to carry.

crockery_crates.name: Crates of Crockery
crockery_crates.flavour: Packed in straw. Half of it arrives as half of it.

chapel_bell.name: Chapel Bell
chapel_bell.flavour: Cast downriver, hauled up by six oxen, and it still has no clapper.

anvils.name: Pair of Anvils
anvils.flavour: Craft Row ordered two. Craft Row will fight for two.

window_lead.name: Rolls of Window Lead
window_lead.flavour: Came up for the chapel glass and stayed for the roofs.

crossbows.name: Chest of Crossbows
crossbows.flavour: Garrison order, sealed. The seal is the only thing bandits respect.

war_harness.name: Bundle of War Harness
war_harness.flavour: Straps, buckles, and the smell of a better stable than ours.

dried_fruit.name: Crates of Dried Fruit
dried_fruit.flavour: Figs, dates, apricots. The market town learned the words this year.

linen_bales.name: Bales of Fine Linen
linen_bales.flavour: Woven somewhere flat and sunny. Bellmire is neither.

iron_grating.name: Load of Iron Grating
iron_grating.flavour: For the gate and for the drains. Both keep things out.

lens_blanks.name: Case of Lens Blanks
lens_blanks.flavour: Ground glass for spectacles. Worth more than the cart under it.

amber.name: Casket of Amber
amber.flavour: Sea-stone from a coast nobody here has seen. Warm in the hand.

coin_chest.name: Sealed Coin Chest
coin_chest.flavour: The guild's own, under seal, with four guards who pretend it is grain.

ox_yokes.name: Crate of Ox Yokes
ox_yokes.flavour: Shaped elsewhere by a man who never meets the ox. They fit anyway.

nail_kegs.name: Kegs of Nails
nail_kegs.flavour: Dull, heavy, and the first thing a burned-out row asks the road for.

seed_flax.name: Flax Seed
seed_flax.flavour: Next year's cloth, riding in a sack this year. Bandits never bother with it.

hide_bales.name: Bales of Hide
hide_bales.flavour: Stiff, stinking, and worth a month of somebody's work once the tanner has them.

market_scales.name: Crate of Scales
market_scales.flavour: Beam and pan, packed in straw. A market day runs on being believed.

salt_barrels.name: Barrels of Salt
salt_barrels.flavour: Keeps meat, keeps fish, keeps a town through a bad winter. Worth stealing.

votive_wax.name: Votive Wax
votive_wax.flavour: Blocks of it, pale as a knuckle. The chapel burns more than the town expects.

psalter_crates.name: Crate of Psalters
psalter_crates.flavour: Copied downriver by hands that never saw Bellmire. Still, they name the river.

forge_coal.name: Forge Coal
forge_coal.flavour: Burns hotter than anything cut from the fen. Craft Row is built on it.

rivet_stock.name: Rivet Stock
rivet_stock.flavour: Drawn wire by the coil. It becomes a thousand small things nobody praises.

pike_staves.name: Pike Staves
pike_staves.flavour: Ash, straight-grained, cut long. The heads are fitted here, where they are needed.

shield_blanks.name: Shield Blanks
shield_blanks.flavour: Unpainted limewood. The Garrison paints them itself, and never the same twice.

ginger_crates.name: Crate of Ginger
ginger_crates.flavour: Worth more than the cart. The carter sleeps on it and says he does not.

pepper_sacks.name: Sacks of Pepper
pepper_sacks.flavour: Weighed against silver in better towns. Here it is weighed against silver too.

crane_cordage.name: Crane Cordage
crane_cordage.flavour: Coil on coil of it. A wall goes up at the speed the rope allows.

quarry_wedges.name: Quarry Wedges
quarry_wedges.flavour: Iron and oak. They split the stone the wall is counted in.

paving_stone.name: Dressed Paving Stone
paving_stone.flavour: Squared at the quarry, hauled slow. Every street costs a season of these.

lead_pipe.name: Lead Pipe
lead_pipe.flavour: For the conduits. The town argues about the cost and lays it anyway.

ivory_combs.name: Ivory Combs
ivory_combs.flavour: Cargo that exists to prove the road is safe enough to carry it.

gilt_frames.name: Gilt Frames
gilt_frames.flavour: Gold leaf over nothing much. The point was never the wood.

stock_by_tier._note: Stock gating by growth tier (D35/D39 + D31/D32). Tiers are the 12 stages of lore_lines.growth_tiers.tiers, in order, 1-12. CUMULATIVE: a town at tier N shows every shop_adds key from tiers 1..N, and caravans carry every cargo_adds key from tiers 1..N. Nothing is ever removed as the town grows. Every key here exists in shop_stock / trader_cargo above. A crossing must not sell glass. Dead until wired.
